decisions.difference: A: (none)  vs  B: (diagnosis Disorder of thyroid gland possible) when palpitations, temperature < 38 °C and an explicit No to each dehydration sign
decisions.final_expr: (and (clinical_finding Palpitations) (< (measurement Body temperature °C) 38) (no Thirst due to water deprivation) (no Xerostomia) (no Decreased skin turgor) (no Decreased urine output)) -> (diagnosis (snomed_concept "Disorder of thyroid gland" "disorder") possible)
decisions.reason: The page says "If none of the above, consider thyroid ... abnormalities", and a "consider X" becomes a possible rule. B excludes only the parts of "none of the above" that can be encoded (fever, dehydration). Anaemia, pregnancy, medication and the ECG branch can't be expressed, so the rule fires more often than the page intends.

decisions.difference: A: (none)  vs  B: (diagnosis Electrolyte imbalance possible) with the same partial "none of the above" gating
decisions.final_expr: (and (clinical_finding Palpitations) (< (measurement Body temperature °C) 38) (no Thirst due to water deprivation) (no Xerostomia) (no Decreased skin turgor) (no Decreased urine output)) -> (diagnosis (snomed_concept "Electrolyte imbalance" "disorder") possible)
decisions.reason: "consider ... electrolyte abnormalities" is a consider-X statement on the page. It has the same partial-gating caveat as the thyroid rule.

notes: Both builds passed. They agree on the trigger, the whole urgent priority rule (apart from the weakness/numbness concepts), and the heart failure, stroke/TIA and dehydration rules. The final build is B's lisp, provenance and flowchart unchanged. A's remaining-questions point about heart failure history via active_condition was merged into the clinician questions. The task name "Check for causes of palpitations" (B) was kept over "Check for dehydration in palpitations" (A) because it mirrors the page's "Check for fever, dehydration, anaemia, pregnancy and medication side effects". Hb < 8, the ECG branches, anaemia, pregnancy and medication review stay unmodelled in both builds.
